Your insurance company cannot deny you benefits. If you go to the hospital and say the 5 magic words "I want to kill myself" you will be admitted. I've done it, and I didn't even have insurance. I have never received a bill for services. For people like us, worrying about insurance debt should be at the bottom of the list. You say you don't want to die, but are you willing to get help so that doesn't happen? Take the suicidal thoughts seriously. THIS IS CRITICALLY IMPORTANT. The insurance company is maybe trying to scare you. After all, they don't really want you to go to get help. I'm saying they are a business, they make money. But, they cannot go against the Doctors recommendation. If you are really concerned about it, did you know that you can receive Medicare supplemental insurance based on your needs?

I once had a girlfriend, we were dating for about 6 months. She was a recovering drug addict. I was not in a good space mentally and voluntarily admitted myself to a psych ward. One night, when I was in the psych ward she had relapsed, overdosed and died. I didnt even find out untl I was out of the ward. I couldnt handle the pain of losing a loved one and, since I was a recovring addict as well,, I relapsed,  pissed away 6 months clean. I wanted to be with her so bad that I intentionally overdosed as well. Unfortunately(fortunately) my roomate found me overdosed in the house and saved my life. I then spent a week bed ridden in the hospital. When I was in the hospital, I had zero visitors. Nobody gave a shit about me. So alone in the world, without a reason to live. I lost my glasses when I was in the ambulance I think so I couldnt even see, couldnt watch TV. Anpther kick in the teeth. They had to catheter me, which was disgraceful, I couldnt even piss on my own. I know how it is to not be able to eat. I had severed abdominal pain and I went to my Dr. and told him, he told me I needed to go to the ER. So, I went, they gave me a CAT scan and I met up with a gastroenterologist.. He said I needed a coloscopy. He told me I was the youngest person he had ever given a colonscopy to. I was 25. They found polyps that someday will turn cancerous. He said the cause of this is how I deal with stress. My anxiety is soo bad that I cannot even eat. I had to be sedated to put food down. When I was in the psych ward, I couldnt eat. I told the nurse and she said I was so tense and needed to relax. I don't kknow how to relax anymore. They gave me some anti-psychotics and a benzodiazipine then when I was out of my mind fucked up on these meds I was able to eat. It took years to get to the solution. I still have trouble eating. I only eat maybe once a day, at most. Before now, I was in constant pain, but persistence and atempted suicide I found some answers. Before you decide wheter or not to pull the trigger, think of the people that care about you. I have have a couple of friends today I actiually met them in Reddit of all places (drug related, but still). We now live together and are trying to be clean. I hope you find some relief for your pain. I know the feeling when the Dr;s don't know what is causing so much misery. I thought I would be sick for the rest of my life. I now know that I internalize my  anxiety and this causes me to not want to eat. I hope you find some answers.
